description: Interactive matching exercise connecting chapter summary key ideas to concrete examples from the CBSE Grade 7 Mathematics Decimals chapter. Redesigned with Singularity Design System — purple/orange palette, Poppins font, gradient accents. Students click statements then examples to match. Green connecting SVG lines for correct matches. Confetti + gradient congratulations animation when all matched correctly.
subject: Mathematics
topic: Chapter Summary — Key Ideas of the Decimal System
learningObjectives: Reinforce understanding of decimal system key ideas by linking abstract concepts to concrete chapter examples
Assess student recall of chapter content through interactive matching
Connect summary points to real scenarios: measurement accuracy, place value structure, decimal notation, and decimal operations
teachingNotes: Use as the final chapter activity. Students match without notes first, then verify. Discuss mismatches as a class for deeper understanding.
instructionsForStudent: Match each key idea to the example that best illustrates it. Think back to the chapter!

pairs.statement: Splitting units into smaller parts gives accuracy
pairs.example: Sonu's screws needed tenths of a cm to tell them apart
Folding paper: each tenth splits into 10 hundredths

pairs.statement: The decimal point separates whole from fractional part
We can compare, locate, add, and subtract decimals
Place value extends to the right of ones
Trailing zeros don't change decimal value

practice.description: Students match key ideas to examples interactively

features: Singularity Design System: #4A4DC9 primary, #FF7212 accent, #533086→#FC9145 gradient
Poppins font loaded via Google Fonts CDN
Pill-shaped title chip with gradient sparkle icon
Key Ideas column: light purple (#C1C1EA) cards with deep indigo text
Examples column: light peach (#FFF3E4) cards with deep brown text, shuffled order
Click-to-match: select statement → select example → instant feedback
Green curved SVG lines with glow backdrop drawn on correct matches
Red dashed line + shake animation on incorrect attempts
Rounded square (8px radius) number/letter badges with gradient fills
Selected state: 2px primary/accent border, scale(1.025), directional translateX shift, glow shadow
Correct state: success green light fill, check icon badge, correctGlow animation
Gradient progress bar: primary→accent fill, bouncy width transition
Congratulations banner: full #533086→#4A4DC9→#FC9145 gradient, celebrateBounce animation
Confetti particles in design system colors
Reset button: Singularity Outlined style — pill shape, 40px height, 2px border, hover→primary color, press scale(0.95)
Teaching tip footer with muted text hierarchy
Decorative gradient accent lines flanking column headers
animations: smBadgePop — award icon pop in congrats
